rationale: Top 10, in order: I075 (outbound contact-rate/TCPA managed service: $5K capital, first dollar in ~2 months, the asker already runs the exact playbook and owns the DID dashboard), I017 (show-rate guarantee desk: $10K, performance-priced so buyers say yes fast, perfect fit), I050 (spreadsheet-to-app studio: $2K, fixed-fee projects close in weeks, AI-assisted solo shipping is his existing skill), I085 (dialer migration plus contingency telecom audit: $2K, sells on savings, 10/10 fit), I082 (fractional contact-center head: $0 capital, highest reachable median at $150K, only cost is relationship ramp), I076 (book-rate turnaround for PE trades platforms: $2K, $25-60K engagements), I048 (aged-lead AI SDR: $5K, pay-per-show removes buyer friction), I036 (enterprise AI-voice AE: $0 capital, $180K median, contact-center domain is the hook), I093 (LinkedIn ghostwriting: $0, first dollar in a month), I038 (storm roofing 1099 sales: $2K, no license, commission in month one). The next five fell just short: I094 AI-literacy training is cheap and fast but its window is closing and credibility must be built; I001 pest control is well-documented but needs a TDA license and $40K before route density pays; I066 senior-living placement carries FTC/state disclosure risk and lead cost; I037 FDE contracting hits technical-interview screens that AI-assisted shipping does not pass; I081 membership retention desk has a slow human sell against dunning software. Fatal/near-fatal cards (I025, I027, I030, I073, I007, I079, I091, I096, I099) sit at the bottom; nothing in the dossiers overturned those flags.
